name: DHL Supply Chain - DC - Etna OH

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to the DHL Supply Chain (Exel/Coty) building at 127-143 Heritage Drive, Pataskala OH 43062 (Etna Township, Licking County). Roster gave no address; web research surfaced 'COTY/EXEL (DHL), 131 Heritage Dr' and Panjiva shipping records 'Dc Etna, 127-143 Heritage Dr'. Google Geocoding API returned ROOFTOP precision for 131 Heritage Dr; Street View confirmed office unit '138' on the south face within the 127-143 range.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Black cantilever sliding gate across the truck driveway on the west side off Heritage Drive, confirmed in multiple Street View frames (2024-08).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible beside the gate in any Street View angle.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated entry with no guard shack implies kiosk / call-box / app check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: West face of the ~350m building is a continuous dock wall with trailers backed in; counted ~70 doors as a banded estimate (band 50+). Low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked in the fenced truck court west of the building; estimated 25-50 stalls. Court is shared/adjacent with the western building so capacity is approximate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Etna Corporate Park, an edge-of-town industrial park in rural Etna Township surrounded by farmland and a small residential pocket; classified Rural per rubric tiebreak.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; road-served DC.

citations.claim: A 250,000 SF DC at 10300 Schuster Way, Etna OH was built speculative with no committed tenant; DHL is NOT named.
DHL Supply Chain's new 755k SF Ohio building is in Violet Township (near Westerville HQ), NOT Etna.

verification.rationale: No Tier-1 source ties DHL Supply Chain to a specific operating building in Etna; the only addressed Etna DC is speculative with no DHL tenant, and DHL's real Ohio build is in Violet Township (idx 8). No exact-address positive found.
